name: 0.2026.10.12b
body:
This prerelease contains a set of prebuilt binary packages which are up to date as of October 12th, 2026 (from https://github.com/tesselslate/waywall/commit/300868207819618025d71ce98b03972868adafd5).

This is a hotfix. Refer to the release notes for 0.2026.10.11 to see what has changed since the last prerelease. This release exists and supersedes 0.2026.10.12 because I broke the build environment and accidentally built the Arch packages with sanitizers.

Minor changes since 0.2026.10.11:
- Added `waywall.set_raw_sensitivity` to the Lua API

This prerelease contains a set of prebuilt binary packages which are up to date as of October 11th, 2026 (from 0265dc4e48f579706fcf651f2db8d9781c10ddef).

Major changes since 0.2026.06.13:
- Added support for Minecraft 26.3 (@me-nx)
- Added support for raw input sensitivity multiplier (@me-nx)
- Fixed a crash when using River 0.4
- Fixed the River crash fix causing a crash when using Jay (@stateforests)

Minor changes since 0.2026.06.13:
- Subprocesses are killed with SIGTERM instead of SIGKILL (@lesarxd)
- Added logging for `XDG_SESSION_DESKTOP` (@me-nx)
- Fixed MCSR Launcher instances not being recognized (@me-nx)
- Fixed a typo in a log message
- Fixed a crash when spawned subprocesses exit on NVIDIA systems
- Fixed a crash when the same coroutine resumes more than once

This prerelease contains a set of prebuilt binary packages which are up to date as of June 13th, 2026 (from d53c2e42f5f28dd19b3b47c7d79a562e6c790e00).

Minor changes since 0.2026.02.06:
- Fixed a crash with resizing the window on NVIDIA systems
- Fixed a crash with leaving the window obscured for an extended period of time on NVIDIA systems
- Fixed a crash after the game renders 15.7 million frames
- Fixed a crash with other applications using certain Wayland requests
- Reset scheduling policy for child processes

This prerelease contains a set of prebuilt binary packages which are up to date as of February 6th, 2026 (from https://github.com/tesselslate/waywall/commit/26242bd654f1db295808c6e4d8315d2e2124ea6e).

Major changes since 0.2026.01.11:
- Added the option to provide an offset to `ninb_anchor` for more granular positioning
- Added the option to configure the resolution used during fullscreen. This is especially useful for users who use a display scale other than 1
- Moved the default log directory to `$XDG_STATE_HOME/waywall` and implemented log rotation
- Enabled the use of `waywall.sleep()` in event listener coroutines

Minor changes since 0.2026.01.11:
- The `app_id` and title are now set immediately to allow window rules to work on certain compositors (e.g. Niri)
- The config file autogeneration check is now more specific
- Fixed an issue with alpha blending not working correctly with translucent images
- Fixed an issue with `--no-env-reexec` deleting most environment variables from the game's environment

This prerelease contains a set of prebuilt binary packages which are up to date as of January 11, 2026 (from 603aab2b492dab40a8d088be1131cb282c1cd2a2).

Major changes since 0.2025.12.30:
- Added `load` event to `waywall.listen()`
- Added automatic config file generation on first launch
- Added a fix for a Smithay bug which broke Ninjabrain Bot
- Partially eliminated rare freezes on Nvidia due to libwayland 1.24

This prerelease contains a set of prebuilt binary packages which are up to date as of December 30th, 2025 (from https://github.com/tesselslate/waywall/commit/9435a4cb0bcb44507807768329edf251ac695500).

Major changes since 0.2025.12.20:
- Fixed a bug in some Hyprland environments where scene objects would freeze on screen after being deleted
- Fixed mouse movement breaking with ingame fullscreen
- Added partial support for running Minecraft under X11
- Added environment passthrough to allow some PrismLauncher options to work correctly

This prerelease contains a set of prebuilt binary packages which are up to date as of December 20th, 2025 (from 3de3540). Thanks to @ByPaco10 for their work on the new packaging script, which builds binary packages for various distributions!

This prerelease includes packages for Arch Linux, Debian 13, and Fedora 42.
